```{webr-r}
#| context: interactive

overall_grade <- function() {
  weights <- c(final = 0.25, 
               quizzes = 0.15, 
               midterm1 = 0.15, 
               homework = 0.15, 
               github = 0.025, 
               lab = 0.025, 
               attendance = 0.05, 
               progstatexp = 0.05, 
               proficiencytest = 0.15)
  scores <- c(final = 92, 
             quizzes = 98, 
             midterm1 = 88, 
             homework = 95, 
             github = 100, 
             lab = 90, 
             attendance = 100, 
             progstatexp = 100, 
             proficiencytest = 95)
  sum(scores*weights)
}

overall_grade()
```
